verdict.rationale: Segment's sources catalog lists a third-party cloud app source (Shopify - Powered by Fueled), so data can come from apps other than your own instrumented ones. The docs also say it captures 'data from any source' and resolves identity across 'third-party partner touch-points'. Functions let you create custom sources within the workspace to bring new types of data in. Evidence is thin, though: only a single cloud-app source is named, and nothing explains how cloud-app sources sync or how feeds are ingested. missing for 10: breadth of the cloud-app source catalog, documentation of cloud-source sync behavior (schedule, objects pulled), evidence for ingesting external data feeds, independent or hands-on corroboration.
